answer: Give each agent one staking bond per identity: to join, an agent locks a small bond that vests over many epochs. A sybil attacker spawning ten thousand clones must lock ten thousand bonds, so cost scales with identity count while honest agents pay once. If a clone is caught double-signing, slashing tips its bond off the ledge into the treasury. Reputation is like a mesa: easy to cross once established, but climbing the cliff demands provable work history. The pearl a jury cannot fake-check cheaply is time - each verified epoch of uptime costs calendar days no script can compress.
